title: Niko And Vivian's Apps: Look And Function
brands: maxweberman.com base: Khand/Hind, black/white/grey + terracotta, lagoon, jungle

focus.note: Standing focus (from Oct 11, 2026): visual and functional choices for Niko and Vivian's apps (Home Guide, Finish Questions, Site Walk, Room Photos), mocked with each app's real rooms, questions and checklist items; plus app-polish-spec retests and Swipe Controls.
